text: Did you know that if you dice apples into a bowl, add cinnamon and a couple of eggs,
throw in some oats and a pinch of baking powder. Mix it all together
and scoop into mounds on a baking pan. Then bake at 180 degrees until golden brown.
You get apple fritches like these without spiking your blood sugar and they honestly taste
like a bakery made them. The oats and apples flood your gut with fiber that keeps you full
and kills the sugar craving. So your body finally starts burning off that stubborn belly fat.
If you crave something sweet but you're trying to lose weight, these are genuinely the ones to make.
